$comment: Machine-readable map of this scaffold's provenance, used by src/generate-workflow-scaffold.js (stampWorkflowScaffold) to drive substitution and by tooling to audit what shipped. Source: AppianDemo/mgp (Hexaware Manufacturing Governance Platform, an Appian migration demo). Do not hand-edit paths here without updating the actual tree.

tokens.{{PLATFORM_NAME}}: Human-readable product name, e.g. "Acme Claims Platform". Replaces "Manufacturing Governance Platform" and "HexaMGP".
tokens.{{platform_slug}}: Lowercase kebab/snake identifier, e.g. "acme-claims". Replaces lowercase "mgp" (docker network name, py-shared package dir/name, minio bucket prefix, npm scope).
tokens.{{PLATFORM_SLUG_UPPER}}: Uppercase identifier, e.g. "ACME_CLAIMS". Replaces uppercase "MGP" (env var prefixes, brand-mark spans, BPMN process id prefix).
tokens.{{platform_docker_network}}: Reserved token name; in this extraction pass the docker network name was folded into {{platform_slug}} directly (docker-compose `networks: [{{platform_slug}}]`). Generator may treat platform_docker_network as an alias of platform_slug unless a project needs them to differ.
tokens.{{platform_seed_email_domain}}: Email domain used for seeded demo users, e.g. "acmeclaims.local". Replaces "mgp.local".
tokens.{{PLATFORM_BASE_AGENT_CLASS}}: Base agent class name, e.g. "BaseAcmeClaimsAgent". Replaces "BaseMGPAgent" in services/agent-service/app/agents/base.py and its subclass imports.
